items.name: Math Landscapes
items.purpose: Interactive, hierarchical reference site organizing mathematics via the MSC2020 classification system, with mind maps, indices, learning paths, and open textbook collections.
items.relationshipToEdbird: Independent project demonstrating knowledge organization, information architecture, and educational platform design.

items.name: Gamify
items.purpose: A poker-themed productivity app built on the Pomodoro Technique. Timed focus sessions earn poker chips based on duration and self-rated quality, with progress tracked across 12 poker ranks from Fish to GOAT.
items.audience: Students, developers, writers, and anyone using timed focus sessions to build productivity habits.
items.relationshipToEdbird: Independent project demonstrating gamification design, habit-formation mechanics, and full-stack app development with Supabase auth.
